params.expiresAt: Unix time after which the key stops working, or 0 for no expiry.

returns.walletId: The new wallet's id (ids start at 1).

params.ttlSeconds: How long the owner has to approve, 1 second to MAX_REQUEST_TTL.

MAX_OPEN_REQUESTS_PER_AGENT().notice: Most approval requests one agent can have open in one wallet at the same time.

MAX_REQUEST_TTL().notice: Longest time an approval request can stay open.

USDC_TOKEN().notice: USDC on Arc, used through its ERC-20 interface (6 decimals).

addAgent(uint256,address,string,uint256,.notice: Gives `agentAddress` a spending key on the wallet, or re-enables / relabels an existing agent. Re-adding an agent keeps what it already spent today, so it can't reset its daily limit.

agentPay(uint256,address,uint256,string).notice: Pays `amount` USDC from the wallet to `to`, if every rule passes. Called by an agent.

approveRequest(uint256).notice: Approves and pays a request. Owner only, before the request's TTL ends, while the requesting agent is still active and unexpired, and only if the recipient is still allowed. Approved payments don't count toward the agent's daily limit.

createWallet().notice: Creates a wallet owned by the caller.

deposit(uint256,uint256).notice: Moves `amount` USDC from the owner into the wallet. The owner must first approve this contract on the USDC token. Only the wallet's owner can deposit.

expireRequest(uint256).notice: Releases a request's reservation once its TTL has passed, or at any time if the agent that made it was revoked or has expired. Anyone can call it.

expireRequests(uint256[]).notice: Releases several requests in one transaction (see expireRequest). Anyone can call it. Requests that are not pending, or not yet releasable, are skipped.

getAgent(uint256,address).notice: An agent's settings. `spentToday` is what the agent has spent in the current UTC day.

getPendingRequests(uint256).notice: Ids of the wallet's requests that are still PENDING, including ones whose TTL has passed but that nobody has released yet. Order is not guaranteed.

getRequest(uint256).notice: A request as stored. Unknown ids return an empty request (agent == address(0)).

getRequestState(uint256).notice: Whether a request can be approved now, and whether expireRequest would release it now.

isAllowlisted(uint256,address).notice: Returns whether `recipient` is on the allowlist for `walletId`.

isBlocklisted(uint256,address).notice: Returns whether `recipient` is on the blocklist for `walletId`.

isRecipientPermitted(uint256,address).notice: Returns whether `recipient` can currently be paid from `walletId` (recipient checks only).

openRequestCount(uint256,address).notice: How many requests `agentAddress` has open in the wallet.

pauseWallet(uint256,bool).notice: Pauses or resumes every agent of the wallet. Owner actions keep working while paused.

rejectRequest(uint256).notice: Rejects a request and releases its reservation. Owner only.

rejectRequests(uint256[]).notice: Rejects several requests in one transaction. Owner of every request's wallet only. Requests that are no longer pending are skipped.

requestPayment(uint256,address,uint256,s.notice: Asks the owner to approve a payment, usually one over the agent's limits. Reserves `amount` so it can't be spent twice. Recipient rules apply.

revokeAgent(uint256,address).notice: Revokes an agent immediately. Its open approval requests become void: they can't be approved any more and anyone can release their reservations with expireRequest.

setAllowlist(uint256,address,bool).notice: Adds `recipient` to (or removes it from) the wallet's allowlist.

setBlocklist(uint256,address,bool).notice: Adds `recipient` to (or removes it from) the wallet's blocklist. Blocked always wins.

setRecipientMode(uint256,uint8).notice: Lets agents pay anyone (ANY) or only allowlisted recipients (ALLOWLIST).

updateAgent(uint256,address,uint256,uint.notice: Changes an existing agent's limits and expiry. Does not re-enable a revoked agent.

withdraw(uint256,uint256).notice: Sends `amount` of the wallet's unreserved USDC to the owner. Works while paused.
